0.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_000
0.description: A fearsome All Saints' Wake to you! We're preparing a delightfully unsettling attraction that I will be pleased to introduce you to very soon, but I'm afraid all is not in readiness yet. Why don't you join the revelers at our masquerade in the meantime?

1.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_010
1.description: Greetings! Our haunted manor is now ready for visitors! Shall I tell you more about what waits within, or show you directly to the front door?

10.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_ABOUTMENU_GAMERULE
10.description: What is there to do inside?

16.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_120
16.description: Well, it <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> a haunted house! The amusements we have planned will leave you white-knuckled and trembling!

17.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_121
17.description: From the moment you enter the manor, you will have thirty minutes to complete three games chosen at random. Should you prove successful, you will earn yourself a special treat!

18.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_122
18.description: Oh, did I mention that the rooms and hallways are wandered by blood-curdling apparitions?

19.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_123
19.description: Should these ghastly residents discover your presence, they will transform you into a pumpkin! Not permanently, of course. How else would they enjoy hunting you down over and over again!?

20.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_124
20.description: Repeated transformations will take their toll on your sanity, reducing you to a gibbering mess. Once this happens, I'm afraid we'll be forced to evict you in favor of fresh vict─ Er, visitors!

21.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_SYSTEM_000_125
21.description: Haunted Manor participants will be given a sanity meter. Once this value reaches zero, you will be ejected from the instance.

22.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_140
22.description: Why, of course! We have an entire troupe of circus members, er, “disguised” as horrifying ahrimans and ephemeral wisps. They will be roaming the halls, and casting enchantments on clumsy intruders!

23.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_141
23.description: Unless you wish to spend much of your visit as a pumpkin, you would do well to avoid the ahriman's one-eyed gaze.

24.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_142
24.description: As for the wisps, they see little but hear all! Creep slowly and quietly lest your footfalls betray your presence!

25.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_RULEMENU_EVENTRULE_1
25.description: Which game will you ask about?

34.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_200
34.description: Pumpkin Hunt will have you searching for pumpkin-shaped treasure chests inside the manor.

35.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_201
35.description: Will you be able to find all six chests before time runs out!?

36.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_210
36.description: Coffercracker is an amusement in which you must locate the titular coffer and crack open its lid!

37.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_211
37.description: Sound simple? And so it would be were it not for the locking enchantment! To dispel this arcane safeguard, one must stand before the coffer and intone the correct combination of five numbers.

38.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_212
38.description: But do not despair! There are hints conveniently penned on pieces of parchment...which are scattered inconveniently around the manor.

39.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_213
39.description: If you have not the stomach for searching, you might simply guess the numbers. But be prepared for a shock should you utter the wrong combination!

40.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_SYSTEM_000_214
40.description: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter a five-digit number while targeting the coffer.

41.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_SYSTEM_000_215
41.description: Entering the correct combination will open the coffer. Entering the wrong sequence, however, will reduce your reserve of sanity points.

42.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_YSTEM_000_216
42.description: Please be aware that the contents of a note will only be seen by the player who reads it, so be sure to share any hints you find with the rest of the party.

43.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_220
43.description: Arcane Circles will have you and your companions scouring the manor for four mysterious patterns laid out on its floors.

44.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_221
44.description: Once they are found, each of you must choose a circle to stand in to complete the task.

45.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_222
45.description: You need not step inside the patterns at the exact same moment, but as long as one of the circles is left unoccupied the game will not end!

46.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_230
46.description: In this game, you must use smoldering coals to light the jack-o'-lanterns scattered around the manor.

47.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_231
47.description: But be swift! Find and ignite all four lanterns before time runs out!

48.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_240
48.description: Cookie Hunt will have you creeping about the manor in search of treat-filled baskets.

49.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_241
49.description: The color of the basket determines the number of cookies it holds, so spend your time wisely! You will need to collect fifteen cookies in total to win the game!

50.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_250
50.description: Jack-in-the-Box is not for the faint of heart! You'll encounter a multitude of chests during this game, but only two of them should be opened.

51.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_251
51.description: Should you choose to flip the lids at random, you might be in for a fright!

52.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_252
52.description: Your sanity would be better served by seeking out the hints hidden throughout the manor─they'll point you towards the right floor and the right room!

53.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_253
53.description: Opening the wrong chest during the Jack-in-the-Box game will cause a loss of sanity points. Find the hints to piece together the locations of the untrapped containers.

54.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_254
54.description: Please be aware that the contents of a note will only be seen by the player who reads it, so be sure to share any hints you find with the rest of the party.

55.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_260
55.description: In the game of Skinchanger, a mischievous imp has transformed itself into a pumpkin-shaped treasure chest which exactly resembles the others hidden around the manor.

56.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_261
56.description: The only way to find the imp is by collecting and using the truesight smoke bombs! A normal pumpkin will emit red smoke...but the voidsent trickster will be betrayed with blue!

57.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_262
57.description: When you discover the right pumpkin, investigate the chest to force the impostor to reveal itself. Make sure to use the smoke bomb first, or the creature will continue to ignore you!

58.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_SYSTEM_000_263
58.description: A truesight smoke bomb must be used on the pumpkin impostor before it can be revealed.

59.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_130
59.description: Oh, no! No fighting! But there will be plenty of sneaking and hiding! In fact, you might even find a magical charm or two to help you avoid detection by the manor's relentless denizens!

60.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_131
60.description: Such charms are fleeting, however, so be sure to make the most of their brief effects!

61.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_110
61.description: Alone? Oh, dear me, no! We <hex:021A020203>insist<hex:021A020103> that you bring friends to share the experience. Our activities have been designed to set a quartet of companions to quivering, you see!

62.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_111
62.description: The Haunted Manor is a light party instance (four players). There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.

63.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_112
63.description: Parties that register for the instance with less than four members will be filled out automatically via the matching system.

64.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_113
64.description: To register as a party, all party members must be within the same area.

65.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_150
65.description: Yes, actually, we do! We reward everyone who visits our Haunted Manor with creepy treats!

66.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_151
66.description: Even better, these cookies serve as currency at our seasonal vendors. If there's some festival finery you can't yet afford, you can always return to the manor to add to your batch!

67.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_100
67.description: Ah, 'tis a grand old house we borrowed from a grand old family to help celebrate the season of All Saints' Wake.

68.name: TEXT_FESHLW2018ENTRANCE_00540_MEMBERC01548_000_101
68.description: We've added some suitably eerie decorations, and organized a number of...“games,” shall we say? I would be happy to explain the rules to you, of course!
